what: The TEN sm_121 cells of contract_version 22, recorded as a digest. They are the first ten elements of lane_eligibility.cells and were the whole array until v24 appended cells on gfx1201.
why_not_the_bytes: A copy of the array would repeat the runtime image pin, and tests/test_runtime_image_pin.py refuses a second copy of that digest in any file that acts. A hash pins the same bytes without holding the pin.
source: src/tessera/serving/runtime_contract.json at contract_version 22 (origin/master 3ec01f26); re-spanned at contract_version 24 (#460) without re-measuring any cell
lifted_by: json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode ten times from the byte after the 'cells' array's opening bracket; the span is the bytes those ten elements occupy, separators and whitespace included, with no trailing comma
